obligations.description: Show the item name, quantity, and unit price
obligations.evidence_rationale: Both tests assert the full formatted line exactly, so a missing or malformed field would fail.

obligations.description: Include the line total (quantity times unit price)
obligations.evidence_rationale: Both tests assert the exact total (3x2.5=7.50, 1x4=4.00); a wrong total formula would fail.

obligations.description: Format money as USD with two decimals and a leading $
obligations.evidence_rationale: Both tests assert exact $ formatting ($2.50, $7.50, $4.00); wrong formatting would fail.

obligations.description: Show negative-quantity returns with the quantity and total in parentheses
obligations.evidence_rationale: No test exercises a negative quantity, and the behavior is unimplemented, so nothing establishes it.

gaps.description: Returns (negative quantity) are not shown in parentheses; the fourth stated rule is unimplemented and untested
